_comment: Initial broad scan — mutate every TS file under both apps' src/ except UI surfaces (page.tsx/layout.tsx/components/**) which mostly contain composition, not testable business logic. Re-scope per-PR via the --mutate CLI flag.
_comment_coverage: perTest is ~5x faster but cannot kill mutations on module-load-time constants (e.g. a top-level `new Set([...])` populated with string literals). Stryker marks those as `static: true` and reports them as Survived even when tests would catch them. For files heavy with such constants (lib/auth/permission-grants.ts is the canonical example), run with --coverageAnalysis all via `pnpm mutate:thorough`.
_comment_ignore: Keep .claude (Claude Code worktrees + symlinked skills like .claude/skills/patch) and build outputs out of the sandbox copy. The patch symlink crashes the copy with ENOTSUP, and .claude/worktrees holds 11 full node_modules trees. ignorePatterns only affects what's copied into the sandbox, not what's mutated.
_comment_mutate: Excluded files: env.ts in both apps is read+regex-parsed by BP29 §28 schema-discipline meta-tests; Stryker's mutant brackets break that parsing. Exclude similar self-introspected files here if you add more such tests.
